description:
Best for: "write the alt text for my images" or "fix the shouting titles". Builds a CSV of corrected titles and image alt text for the user to review and import.
Returns: csv with only the rows that change (URL handle, Title, Product image URL, Image position, Image alt text), up to 200 rows, with counts per fix and a notice. Advisory: nothing is changed in any store.
Input tips: send exactly one of csv or domain. Optional fixes, any of alt_text, title_whitespace, title_caps (default all three), and alt_text_template with {title}, {vendor}, {type}, {position} (default "{title}"). Errors: both_given, missing_source, csv_too_large, or a feed refusal; then ask for the CSV.
Not for: rewriting descriptions, or changing a live store. Use listing_text_audit first to see what is wrong.

alt_text_template.description: Alt text pattern, such as "{title} by {vendor}, view {position}". Placeholders: {title}, {vendor}, {type}, {position}; any other text is copied as written. Default "{title}".

csv.description: The full text of a Shopify product CSV, header row first, such as "Title,URL handle,Description,Vendor,Price,...". Paste the file exported from Shopify admin (Products > Export) as it is. At most 2 MB; split a larger file by rows and repeat the header in each part. Example call: {"csv": "Title,URL handle,Price\nWool Beanie,wool-beanie,24.00"}

domain.description: A store address such as example.com, sent instead of csv (send exactly one of the two). The store's public /products.json is read once (at most 5 pages of 250 products), after its robots.txt. Large stores often block it; then ask the user for the CSV. Example call: {"domain": "example.com"}

fixes.description: Which fixes to build, such as ["alt_text"]. alt_text: fill empty image alt text from the template. title_whitespace: trim and collapse spaces in titles. title_caps: rewrite all-capital titles in title case. Default: all three.

name: listing_fix_sheet

csv.description: Rows to import: URL handle, Title, Product image URL, Image position, Image alt text. Only rows that change are included.

feed_truncated.description: Present and true when the store has more products than the 5 pages read

host.description: The store host that was read, in domain mode only

notice.description: Fixed reminder to pass on: the sheet is advisory and nothing was changed in any store

rows.description: Data rows in csv, header not counted

source.description: Where the products came from: the csv text or the store's public feed (domain)

totals.description: Fixes found before the sheet was cut to 200 rows

title_caps.description: All-capital titles rewritten in title case

truncated.description: True when more than 200 rows would change

title: Build a CSV of listing text fixes
